Nek'zali the Soulcoiler: [해제] Essence Rend is a Magic effect, so dispel it with Cleanse after the target reaches the edge of the room. A Latent Cultist pool is left where it was removed.
[생존기] Soulcoil Rite goes off with every Phase 2 Invoke, so take a turn using Aura Mastery to reduce damage taken by the raid within 40 yards.
@m [참고] Spells being cast are interrupted the moment Invoke ends, so heal with instant Holy Shock and Word of Glory instead of Holy Light at that moment.

Entombed Sentinels: [해제] Blighted Blood is an 18 sec Magic DoT, so dispel it right away with Cleanse.
[위치] The two groups are more than 40 yards apart, so Aura Mastery and Light of Dawn only reach your own group within 40 yards. Stay with your assigned group.
[광역 피해] While a Venom Coagulation ooze is alive, Contaminate hits the raid every 3 sec, so top up several players at once with Divine Toll and Beacon of Virtue.

Vashnik the Malignant: [해제] Every Cleanse on Exploding Infection makes Caustic Explosion hit the whole raid, so stagger with the other dispellers and clear one player at a time.
@m [생존기] Line up an Aura Mastery turn with Gloom Expulsion and Conflagrating Expulsion, which grow with each Imbibe.

The Lost Explorers: [해제] An Icebound Flames that slips past interrupts is a Magic effect, so dispel it with Cleanse.
[생존기] During Scrollsage Iku's ultimate, line up Aura Mastery or Avenging Wrath with the window when Frostfire Volley debuffs are being cleared.
[탱버] When First Mate Nama's Steady Strikes stacks get high, use Blessing of Sacrifice to reduce the tank's damage taken by 30%.

Sszorak: [탱버] Put Blessing of Sacrifice on the tank taking Ravage to reduce their damage taken by 30%.
[광역 피해] The whole raid takes damage when Venomous Surge ends, so top everyone up right away with Light of Dawn and Divine Toll.
[위치] If you are late to gather in the middle of the arena before the Howling Maelstrom gusts, use Divine Steed for movement speed to join up.

The Twin Fangs: [생존기] Stir the Depths hits the whole raid for 6 sec, so reduce damage taken with Aura Mastery and have Protection of Tyr's healing received increase overlap with it.
@m [분담] Put Beacon of Virtue on players standing in a Tainted Blood source and dump Holy Shock to fill the absorb within 8 sec.
@m [탱버] Put Blessing of Sacrifice on the Ithraz tank stacking healing absorbs from Blood Torrent to reduce their damage taken by 30%.

The Coiled Altar: [생존기] Suffocating Darkness healing absorbs stack up during Veil of Twilight, so raise your healing with Avenging Wrath to strip them.
@hm [생존기] Venom Rupture DoTs stack up right after Sever pops the orbs, so line up Aura Mastery.
[위치] You need to spread past 40 yards right after soaking Guillotine, so keep Divine Steed available.

Ula'tek: [해제] Blightscale Viper's Acidic Burst is a Poison DoT, so clear it with Cleanse, talented into Improved Cleanse.
@hm [해제] Blightscale Rawling's Poisonous Bite stacks are also Poison, so clear them with Cleanse.
[생존기] Split Aura Mastery and Avenging Wrath between the 20 sec of Rage of the Shackled raid damage and Fury Unleashed.

Nymrissa Wavecaller: [생존기] Line up an Aura Mastery turn with Unending Tides hitting the raid every second.
[광역 피해] Pop! is raid-wide damage plus a knockback, so top up the scattered players together with Divine Toll and Beacon of Virtue.
@hm [생존기] If a missed Frost Orb stacks up the Shatter DoT, raise your healing with Avenging Wrath to hold through it.

Imperator Averzian: [생존기] On Dark Upheaval at the pull and after each intermission, use Aura Mastery to raise Devotion Aura's damage reduction to 12%.
[광역 피해] When intermission Dark Barrage lands on several players, apply Beacon of Virtue and top them up together with Light of Dawn.
@m [광역 피해] Heal through the 10 sec Lingering Darkness DoT on players dispelled of Void Marked with Holy Shock and Word of Glory.

Vorasius: [해제] The Blisterburst damage taken increase and the Creep Spit movement slow are Magic effects, so dispel them with Cleanse.
[광역 피해] After the raid takes Primordial Roar stacked, top up 5 players within 40 yards at once with Light of Dawn.
@m [생존기] Line up Aura Mastery when the first Blistercreep pack pops.

Fallen-King Salhadaar: [생존기] Use Aura Mastery and Avenging Wrath together on the 20 sec of raid damage from Entropic Unraveling.
[참고] Strip the Oppressive Darkness healing absorb from players coming out of Despotic Command with Holy Shock and Word of Glory.
@hm [광역 피해] When Dark Radiation stacking DoTs are on the raid, top up with Beacon of Virtue and Light of Dawn.

Vaelgor & Ezzorak: [해제] Dread Breath fear is a Magic effect, so dispel affected players right away with Cleanse.
[생존기] Part of the Midnight Flames damage gets through the Radiant Barrier absorb, so reduce raid damage taken with Aura Mastery.
[참고] Keep Beacon of Light on the tank gaining healing absorbs from Rakfang stacks and fill them up with Holy Light.

Lightblinded Vanguard: [해제] The Avenger's Shield DoT is a Magic effect, so dispel it right away with Cleanse.
[분담] Put Beacon of Virtue on the 5 players with the Tyr's Wrath healing absorb and dump Holy Shock and Light of Dawn.
@m [생존기] Pop Aura Mastery when the empowered Searing Radiance damage grows every second.

Crown of the Cosmos: [해제] Corrupting Essence on a player is a Magic effect, so dispel it with Cleanse.
[해제] Cleansing Null Corona moves the absorb to someone else, so fill the absorb with Holy Light and only Cleanse in an emergency.
@nh [광역 피해] Raid damage comes in every second while Cosmic Barrier is up, so hold through it with Beacon of Virtue and Light of Dawn.

Chimaerus the Undreamt God: [해제] Fearsome Cry fear that slips past interrupts is a Magic effect, so dispel it with Cleanse.
@hm [해제] Dispel Consuming Miasma with Cleanse once the target reaches an Alndust Essence pool.
[광역 피해] Strip the Rift Sickness healing absorb applied every time adds spawn from several players at once with Beacon of Virtue and Light of Dawn.

Belo'ren, Child of Al'ar: [광역 피해] Heal off the Light Burn and Void Burn healing absorbs completely with Holy Shock and Word of Glory.
[생존기] Burning Heart comes more often during Phase 2 Rebirth, so raise your healing by 20% with Avenging Wrath.
@m [분담] You can move with Divine Shield active, so you can take the Radiant Echoes orb assignment.

Midnight Falls: [분담] Heal a Dusk Crystal to full with Holy Shock and Holy Light to turn it into a Dawn Crystal.
[광역 피해] During Total Eclipse, strip the Eclipsed healing absorbs with Beacon of Virtue and Light of Dawn, prioritizing crystal carriers.
[생존기] Line up Aura Mastery with the 25 sec of raid damage from Shattered Sky.

Rotmire: @hm [해제] Clear a Poison Burst poison DoT that slips past interrupts with Cleanse, talented into Improved Cleanse.
[생존기] Rotting Pustules makes damage ramp up as the fight goes on, so stack Aura Mastery and Avenging Wrath late in the fight.
[광역 피해] Use Beacon of Virtue and Light of Dawn on the Fungal Bloom raid damage and 16 sec DoT.

note: There is no spec-specific source for each raid boss, so these are general principles written by matching ability tooltips to boss mechanics.
